echoParts: man looks on the outward appearance
but the Lord looks on the heart
verseText: For the Lord sees not as man sees: man looks on the outward appearance, but the Lord looks on the heart.
meaning: People often judge by what they can see on the outside, but the Lord sees what is really in a person's heart.
